result.title: FaceJev: Direct Visual Decisions for Face Forgery Detection
result.summary: Face forgery detection methods often perform well on seen manipulations but generalize poorly to unseen ones. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can recognize facial parts and assess their visual plausibility. Existing MLLM-based methods typically express these judgments through textual explanations, but seldom treat individual part decisions as explicit learning targets. We present FaceJev, an MLLM-based method for face forgery detection through direct visual decisions. Following the Jev formulation, FaceJev answers eight independent questions about facial parts using a shared image encoding and reads anomaly probabilities from the native answer logits. A face is classified as forged if any part is predicted to be abnormal, directly linking the detection result to the part decisions. We construct PartForensics, a dataset of approximately 160k images with binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts, to supervise these decisions. We further propose FS-GRPO, which optimizes each part decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards. FaceJev outperforms the strongest baseline by 7.25 percentage points on unseen manipulations. Extensive ablation studies validate our design choices and the effectiveness of the main components.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FaceJev：让 MLLM 对八个面部区域分别回答独立的二分类问题，共享一次图像编码，并从原生答案 logits 读取异常概率，任一部分异常即判为伪造；同时构建 PartForensics 数据并用 FS-GRPO 优化各部位决策。
AI.relevance_reason: 面部伪造检测属特定应用任务，但其「跳过文本解释、直接从答案 logits 取部位级视觉判断」以及按决策粒度做奖励比较的做法，可供核查 LVR 中答案是否真正使用视觉证据、以及如何监督细粒度证据判断。
